description: Lock a prize pool and invite entries scored against your rubric. Fair defaults: no entries refunds the pool; not judged within 7 days after the deadline splits it equally among entries; cancel only before the first entry.

brief.description: What entrants must deliver and how it will be judged.

deadline.description: ISO date-time, 1 hour to 30 days ahead.

prize_pool_usdc.description: Total prize pool in test USDC, locked now.

prizes_pct.description: Share of the pool per place, e.g. [60, 30, 10].

room.description: Open a room for the competition.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

name: competition_create
title: Host a competition
